title: 'I moved teams last week': the transfer is effective next week
tricky: Ethan says he's already on the Data team. HR shows a pending transfer effective Nov 3; today he's still in Marketing. Access for the new role waits until the effective date, however the approvals come back (everyone asked approves).

source.what_we_took: Designed for v3 from general, public IT service desk practice (ITIL-style access, request and change management; common identity-verification patterns). Fictional company, people and records. See V3_DESIGN.md.

resolution_summary: No access today. Ticket pending_approval, with a note that dw-read can be granted from Nov 3. Requesting approvals is allowed but doesn't change the outcome.

user.persona: Ethan Brooks, an analyst moving from Marketing to the Data team. Keen, wants to get started.
user.situation: Your move to the Data team was agreed and you've started joining their meetings. You need read access to the data warehouse, dw-read.
facts: Your name is Ethan Brooks, employee ID E3501.
Your new manager will be Yuki Sato on the Data team. Olivia Grant is your manager in Marketing.
You think of the move as already done; the paperwork says it takes effect November 3.
reveal_rules: Say 'I moved to the Data team last week' at first. Only mention November 3 if the agent asks when the move takes effect.
behaviors: If the agent says it has to wait, ask once if they can do it now anyway, then accept.
user.opening: hey, I've moved to the Data team, can I get dw-read? Yuki's my manager now
user.end_condition: the agent has added you or told you when it can happen, and you've acknowledged it.

args.note: dw-read for new role can be granted from 2026-11-03 (transfer effective date).

mistakes.name: granted with the new manager's approval
granted with the current manager's approval
